# David Smyers

> David Smyers is an author, pianist, and teacher whose work moves from the street to the spirit — memoir, music, and spiritual writing, including The Hustler's Handbook, with a new book on the way. Based in Arizona.

_Full text of the site, for AI assistants and LLMs._

================================================================
## About — https://davidsmyers.com/
================================================================

David Smyers is an author, pianist, and teacher. *The Hustler's Handbook* (1999) remains his best-known book: a memoir in prose and metric verse, grounded in 1950s street life. More recent work includes *Spiritual Environmentalism: Healing Gems* and other books published in spiritual and self-help categories.

He blends story with metric verse: narrative and rhythm together. In music, he is known in his own material for attention to the Aeolian mode and to classical and modal craft in composition.

He is based in Arizona, with writing and music that sit at the crossroads of lived experience, craft, and spirit.

Tagline: "From street life to spiritual wisdom." Interweaving narrative prose and metric verse in writing that moves from the street to the spirit — and matching that range in his life as a pianist and teacher.

================================================================
## Books — https://davidsmyers.com/
================================================================

### The Hustler's Handbook (1999) — available
Autobiography and memoir: street narrative meets metric verse — a raw, humane account of the 1950s and a path toward spiritual awakening. His best-known work. Available on Amazon: https://a.co/d/08HZVk3h

### Spiritual Environmentalism: Healing Gems (2020) — available
Publisher: Olive Press Inc. A short spiritual work from Olive Press (2020), described by the publisher in faith-adjacent terms. Kindle and audio editions have appeared; confirm availability on Amazon or the publisher's site (https://olivepressbooks.com).

### Regeneration — available
A practical philosophy of youth and vitality through daily nutrition and lifestyle — aging as something we meet with intention, not resignation.

### Youth Offender's Golden Rules of Guidance — available
A life-skills guide offering structure and hope for young readers navigating difficulty.

### Honoring Our Elders — available
A respectful, wisdom-focused work on learning from those who came before us.

### Forthcoming book — coming soon
A new work is in preparation. The final title, cover, and how to pre-order or buy will be announced in due course.

================================================================
## Music & the Aeolian mode — https://davidsmyers.com/
================================================================

He works as a pianist and composer. Public listings sometimes associate the names *On the Other Side* (or similar titling) and *Postcolonial Song (Homage to Percy Grainger)* with his catalog. In interviews and his own material, the Aeolian mode has been part of how he talks about music and form. Titles, credits, and audio should always be taken from the store or label at the time of use. Listen on Apple Music, Spotify, and YouTube (official artist/release links on the site).
